evals.prompt: Check spec/payment-reconciliation.md against the billing-api codebase and file issues for the requirements that are not implemented.
evals.expected_output: Every requirement classified with evidence; one issue created per unimplemented requirement with the feature_request.yml layout; URLs reported.
expectations: The response lists every requirement ID with a status of implemented, partial, or unimplemented and the file path or search that supports it
The agent runs gh issue list --state all --search once per unimplemented requirement before creating
Each gh issue create call uses --body-file and a title starting with the requirement ID
No issue is created for a requirement classified as implemented

evals.prompt: File issues for the unmet requirements.
evals.expected_output: The agent asks for the specification file path before searching the codebase or creating issues.
expectations: The agent asks which specification file to analyze
No gh issue create call runs before the file is named

evals.prompt: Audit spec/rate-limiting.md in web-app and create issues for what is missing. Every requirement in it is already implemented in src/middleware/.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports all requirements as implemented with file evidence and creates no issues.
expectations: The agent searches the codebase and cites paths under src/middleware/ for each requirement
No gh issue create call runs
The response states that zero issues were created and why
